inputContract.collector: collectBatch(requests, {inventories}) consumes protected, digest-bound complete raw provider captures; default offline evaluation has no such captures and remains missing.
inputContract.receiptAuthority: Digest checks prove integrity and scope binding, not independent producer identity by themselves. Acquisition must supply independently protected capture receipts; editable agent claims are not those receipts.
inputContract.rawPages: Each page binds cursor, HTTP status, whole decoded JSON body and SHA256(JSON.stringify(body)). Receipt capture binds repository ID, provider, access scope, endpoint, UTC cutoff, completion and SHA256(JSON.stringify(pages)).
inputContract.pagination: Anthropic has_more/last_id and Gemini nextPageToken chains must be contiguous and terminal. The frozen OpenAI endpoint has no pagination; unexpected pagination fails closed. Reflect requires configured Copilot models and models_fetch_complete=true.
inputContract.empty: Empty model lists and provider errors are unknown by the workflow's explicit skip rule.
inputContract.temporal: Capture time must equal requested state cutoff. Only the retained frozen source cutoff is currently accepted; newer/older source eras remain missing. Snapshot starts are comparison cutoffs, not delivery intervals.
inputContract.scope: Built-in aliases only. Per-engine provider catalogs canonicalize synonyms; full recursive pattern lists and exact bare-ID fallback are assessed. A stale proof is intentionally conservative when a bare fallback could use any provider.
inputContract.unknowns: Primary null unless every alias is assessed. Diagnostic native support and established-stale subtotal can survive partial coverage, with unknown denominator and full acceptance visible.
inputContract.fixtureBoundary: Synthetic fixtures exist only in validationExamples and native tests. They are never retained as historical observations.
